catalog_source.integration: independent fixed-rule reimplementation; repository code is not executed or copied

source_state.initial_trend: up if second close exceeds first close, otherwise down
source_state.initial_sar: first high for up and first low for down, preserving the repository's unusual convention
source_state.position: long when repository real_sar is below completed close, otherwise cash
source_state.first_tradable_signal: second completed bar; ignore zero-initialized first row

negative_controls: fixed deterministic asset-label permutation preserving signal persistence

portfolio.turnover: half L1 change including cash from drifted holdings

promotion_gates.primary_performance: positive annual return, Sharpe above 0.5, and drawdown no worse than -25 percent at 50 bps
promotion_gates.stress: positive full-period and both later-window annual returns at 100 bps
promotion_gates.controls: candidate Sharpe exceeds inverted, stale, and permuted controls at 50 bps
promotion_gates.dependence: absolute correlation no greater than 0.80 to core and trend
promotion_gates.blend: 80/20 core blend improves Sharpe with no worse drawdown and familywise paired lower Sharpe difference above zero
